title: MONETRIX ON HYPERLIQUID
summary_title: Delta neutral yield on hype and stablecoins: Monetrix's transparent on-chain strategy
summary_description: Monetrix builds yield-bearing stablecoins and hype tokens using funding rate arbitrage and portfolio margin on Hyperliquid.

key_moments.label: Monetrix introduces USDM and MX hype yield products
